summary.zh: 用设计令牌搭建可扩展的设计系统
summary.en: Design tokens, theming, and component architecture.

description.zh: 规划设计令牌、主题切换与组件架构，让设计系统能随产品规模一起扩展。适合从零建立设计系统、接入明暗主题，或统一多个产品的组件来源。
description.en: Lays out design tokens, theme switching, and component architecture so a design system scales with the product. Fits building one from scratch, adding light and dark themes, or consolidating components across products.
